_comment.1: OPEN-LOOP capture for contrib/com_survey: one minute of raw ROI frames, same camera configuration as steering_par_fsp_wfs_com.json, with NO tracker, NO fsp and NO DAC in the pipeline. Nothing is actuated, so whatever the beam does here is the beam, not a loop.
_comment.2: Run it with the FSM parked at its normal bias, exactly as contrib/probe_frame.json expects. Let the coarse channels settle (~30 s) before starting, or the drift during settling will show up as beam motion.
_comment.3: Writes com_survey.aylp: 40-byte header per frame (magic u32, version/status/type/units u8 at 4..7, log_dim.y/x u64 at 8/16, pitch.y/x double at 24/32), then height*width uint8. At 64x64 one minute is height*width*fs bytes; MEASURE fs first (see note 4) and check the disk space against it.
_comment.4: count = 60 s * fps, and fps IS NOT KNOWN at this ROI: 381 Hz was the 248x248 rate on the ASI662MM and 3788 Hz the 32x32 rate on the 290, and this is now 64x64 at exposure 400 on the 290 -- a different point from both. Take a short capture, read the achieved rate, then set count. Rescale whenever the ROI or exposure changes; the analyser reads the real frame count from the file and only needs --fs to convert to Hz.
_comment.5: Then: ./build/com_survey com_survey.aylp --fs MEASURED   (add --row-time once you have measured it; it does not affect the recommendation).
_comment.6: SUPERSEDED -- BEAM REPLACED 2026-08-06; re-run this survey and replace the numbers below. The new beam fits the 64x64 ROI, which the old one did not. FOR REFERENCE, measured 2026-08-05 from a 57.6 s capture at the old 248x248 ROI: fs 397-398 Hz (NOT 3788 -- that was the old 32x32), background 3.21 counts sigma 0.40, beam amplitude 251.6, beam sigma 15.83 px / FWHM 37.27 px, saturation 0.02% over the whole record.
_comment.7: RE-VERIFY AGAINST THE NEW BEAM -- this was measured on the old one and the chop belongs to the source, so it may or may not have come with it. AS MEASURED 2026-08-05: THE SOURCE IS CHOPPED at 4.411 Hz (autocorrelation lag 90 frames = 226.7 ms, r 0.69) with ~12% duty at half maximum -- ON 27.7 ms, OFF 186.4 ms, dark/bright flux 2202/208869 counts = 100:1. Verified NOT an alias: the same 8.79/13.38/17.57 Hz harmonics appear at fs 397, 653 and 990 Hz, and an alias would move with the sample rate. CONSEQUENCE: ~90% of frames in a raw capture are dark, which makes both trackers look broken (fit_com 79% rejected, wfs_com 97%) and makes the residual look 'boiling' when it is only dark-frame noise. Analyse the illuminated frames only, or capture CW.

params._roi: 248x248 for this survey, not the 160x160 the loop configs run at: the survey is where the beam's SHAPE is being characterised, and fit_com's gaussian fit and wfs_com's template both want the wings inside the frame rather than clipped by the ROI edge. Centred on the 2026-08-04 find_roi probe, full-sensor beam (1064, 536), so start = 1064-124 / 536-124.
